pages.text: $(#C1B82A)🍯 Amber Nectar · Cooling Secret ✦$()$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)「An oasis for desert travelers, a cooling armor for lava walkers」$()$(br)When $(#FFA500)Rock Honey$() infuses $(#3CB371)Dried Mint$() with its refreshing elements, and $(#F5F5DC)Coastal Daisy Petals$() unfold within $(#DAA520)Golden Syrup$()—a miraculous elixir that $(l)soothes both wounds and scorching heat$() is born.

$(#3CB371)▌ Triple Protection $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)❤ Fountain of Life$()$(br)A warm energy instantly washes away pain.$(br2)$(l)$(#87CEEB)🍃 Wind’s Blessing$()$(br)Feet feel as if gliding over dew-soaked grass.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🔥 Flame Repulsion$()$(br)Even the $(#CD5C5C)heat waves of magma$() shy away.

$(br2)$(#DAA520)▌ Brewing Notes $()$(br)- Blend $(#FFA500)honey$() with $(#AFEEEE)morning dew$() until it forms a $(#AAA4CD)glass-like texture$().$(br)- Grind $(#3CB371)mint leaves$() in a $(#4682B4)clean stone mortar$() until $(#E0FFFF)chilled mist$() rises.$(br)- When adding $(#F5F5DC)coastal daisy pollen$(), stir $(#9370DB)at extreme speed$() clockwise for seven rounds.$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() When $(#7FFF00)emerald ripples$() appear, immediately remove from heat.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Sandsea Tea Ballad 』$()$(br)A nomadic hymn:$(br)'When the $(#FFA500)Honey Queen$() seals summer’s warmth in amber,$(br)and $(#3CB371)mint’s coolness$() meets the resilience of $(#F5F5DC)coastal daisies$()—$(br)this $(#98FB98)emerald nectar$() shall make $(#FF4500)flames$() bow,$(br)and grant those lost in $(#CD853F)the sandstorm$() a $(#FF69B4)new beginning$().'
